name: Ninomiya Shiina
source:
"World's Odyssey was my dream, which makes it my duty to return things back to the way they were!"

A girl who pines for the world from whence she came as she fights to survive inside of the world she created.

Shiina wakes up inside of World's Odyssey, the VRMMORPG which had been cancelled for nearly a year, with no memory of her arrival. She served as the game's director for the duration of its development until her mysterious disappearance. With no way to perform a manual log-out, she sets out to complete the game's perfect ending.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
